title: Roblox_Gubby
description: This texture pack adds Gubby the rabbit from Roblox, replacing the regular Rabbit.
body:
This texture pack adds Gubby the Roblox rabbit, replacing the regular Rabbit.

Gubby is a Roblox rabbit that I decided to bring into Minecraft. He has custom sounds, a spawn egg, skin, and a rabbit leg. Mods like EMF-ETF or OptiFine are required.
